body:
## What & why

`generation_config.json` uses JSON's decimal point, but the native reader converts floating values with `std::stod`, which follows the embedding application's current numeric locale. With a German locale, a valid temperature of `0.625` becomes `0`, changing the sampling configuration.

Give each parser its own C numeric locale and use the platform's locale-specific conversion (`strtod_l` or `_strtod_l`). This keeps the existing native range handling, including underflow and overflow, without changing the process locale. Unknown provider fields continue to be ignored when their numeric values are outside the supported range.

## Area

- [x] Engine, CLI or server (`edge0-infer/`)

## How was it tested?

The production branch contains the same two source/test files as validation commit `62855b4e87f5a42a8d3a98954f5bef29308e1c02`.

- [Linux native validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/Edge0/actions/runs/43955376404/job/133608432523): the original implementation fails the real configuration test with German `0.625` becoming `0`; the revised generation-defaults and model-catalog tests pass. The changed source also compiles against Android API 28.
- [Windows/MSVC native validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/Edge0/actions/runs/43955376404/job/133608432586): the same original-source failure and revised-source success were reproduced with native Windows binaries.
- The regression compares 13 numeric inputs with that platform's original C-locale `std::stod` behavior, including signed zero, binary64 boundaries, subnormal inputs, underflow and overflow. It also checks ignored provider fields and 800 concurrent configuration reads per available locale, verifying that the process locale remains unchanged.
- Local Linux: the two affected tests pass in C, German and French locales after reproducing the original failure. Commands: `cmake --build --preset cpu --target moe_test_model_generation_defaults moe_test_model_catalog` and `ctest --preset cpu --output-on-failure -R '^moe_test_model_(generation_defaults|catalog)$'`.

This is prepared as a draft while platform validation remains incomplete. The macOS native/iOS 17 job was cancelled without a successful validation result. The independent [full Linux L0/L1 comparison](https://github.com/Afloat16/Edge0/actions/runs/43958711925) is queued. Linux and Windows native success does not establish the outstanding macOS/iOS results.

## Checklist

- [ ] Full L0/L1 suite passes.
- [x] Ran the affected native tests on Linux and Windows.
- [x] Added locale, range-compatibility and concurrent-read regressions.
- [x] Reviewed documentation impact: valid JSON generation defaults retain their numeric values independently of the host locale.
